l-m-e4-b01-05.title: Mmejọ mbụ mgbe a na-agụ nnukwu nọmba
l-m-e4-b01-05.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ngwọta iji gụọ 50230000, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ihe na-aga na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-05.material: A gụrụ 50230000 otu a. ① Kewaa ya n'ìgwè mkpụrụọnụọgụ anọ malite n'azụ: 5023|0000 ② A na-agụ 5023 “puku ise na iri abụọ na atọ” ③ Tinye “eok” n'azụ ìgwè dị n'ihu ④ “puku ise na iri abụọ na atọ eok” (1 man = 10,000; 1 eok = 100,000,000)
l-m-e4-b01-05.s.s1.o.a: Nzọụkwụ ①: ikewa ya n'ìgwè mkpụrụọnụọgụ anọ
l-m-e4-b01-05.s.s1.r.b: Ịgụ 5023 dịka “puku ise na iri abụọ na atọ” ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-05.s.s1.r.d: Nke a sitere n'ịgbaso mmejọ dị na ③. Ọ bụghị mmejọ mbụ.
l-m-e4-b01-05.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ìgwè dị n'ihu mkpụrụọnụọgụ anọ ikpeazụ gasịrị, a na-etinye “man”. A na-agụ 50230000 dịka “puku ise na iri abụọ na atọ man”.
l-m-e4-b01-05.s.s2.model.0: Nkeji ìgwè dị tupu mkpụrụọnụọgụ anọ ikpeazụ bụ man, ma etinyere “eok” ebe ahụ, ya mere ③ bụ mmejọ mbụ. Ọ bụ “puku ise na iri abụọ na atọ man”.
l-m-e4-b01-05.s.s2.model.1: 50230000 nwere mkpụrụọnụọgụ asatọ, ya mere nkeji ya bụ man, ọ bụghị eok. Gbanwee ③ ka ọ bụrụ man ma gụọ ya “puku ise na iri abụọ na atọ man”.

l-m-e4-b01-13.title: Njehie mbụ dị na ngwọta 43×26
l-m-e4-b01-13.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta 43×26, ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta n'usoro, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere.
l-m-e4-b01-13.material: E doziri 43×26 otu a. ① 43×6=258 ② 43×2=86 ③ 258+86=344 ④ Azịza ya bụ 344
l-m-e4-b01-13.s.s1.o.c: Nzọụkwụ ③: ịgbakọta uru abụọ ahụ
l-m-e4-b01-13.s.s1.r.c: Ịgbakọta 258 na 86 na-enye 344, nke ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-13.s.s1.r.d: O degharịrị naanị nsonaazụ nke nzọụkwụ bu ya ụzọ; ya mere ọ bụghị njehie mbụ.
l-m-e4-b01-13.s.s1.explain: 2 dị na 26 pụtara 20. 43×20=860, 258+860=1118 bụ azịza ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-13.s.s2.model.0: 2 dị n'ebe iri nke 26 pụtara 20; ya mere ọ kwesịrị ịbụ 43×20=860. 258+860=1118.
l-m-e4-b01-13.s.s2.model.1: Na ②, e dere ngwaahịa ebe iri dịka 86, dị ka ngwaahịa ebe otu; ya mere ọ ezighị ezi. Idozi ya ka ọ bụrụ 860 na-enye azịza 1118.

l-m-e4-b01-21.material: E doziri 3/7+2/7 otu a. ① Ọnụọgụ ndị dị n'okpuru hà nhata ② Tinye ọnụọgụ ndị dị n'elu: 3+2=5 ③ Tinyekwa ọnụọgụ ndị dị n'okpuru: 7+7=14 ④ Nchikọta ya bụ 5/14

l-m-e4-b01-21.s.s1.r.a: Irighiri abụọ ahụ nwere 7 n'okpuru; ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-21.s.s1.o.b: ② Nzọụkwụ gbakwunyere ọnụọgụ ndị dị n'elu
l-m-e4-b01-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ Nzọụkwụ gbakwunyere ọnụọgụ ndị dị n'okpuru
l-m-e4-b01-21.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dere naanị nsonaazụ nke ③, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe mbụ ihe gara ezighi ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-21.s.s1.explain: Mgbe a na-agbakwunye akụkụ nwere otu onye na-ekewa, debe onye na-ekewa ma gbakwunye naanị ndị na-ekpuchi. Nchikọta bụ 5/7.

l-m-e4-b01-29.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ngwọta nke 3.6+0.45, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, n'usoro, wee chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-aga ezighi ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-29.material: A dozịrị 3.6+0.45 dị otú a. ① Dere 3.6 dị ka 3.60 ② Ebe narị 0+5=5 ③ 6+4=10, ya mere dere naanị 0 ma ghara ibu ④ 3+0=3, nchikọta bụ 3.05
l-m-e4-b01-29.s.s1.o.a: ① Nzọụkwụ nke dere 3.6 dị ka 3.60
l-m-e4-b01-29.s.s1.r.a: 3.6=3.60, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-29.s.s1.o.b: ② Nzọụkwụ nke gbakwunyere ebe nke abụọ
l-m-e4-b01-29.s.s1.o.c: ③ Nzọụkwụ nke gbakwunyere ebe nke mbụ
l-m-e4-b01-29.s.s1.o.d: ④ Nzọụkwụ nke gbakwunyere ebe ndị otu
l-m-e4-b01-29.s.s1.r.d: Ọ gara n'ihu site na nsonaazụ hapụrụ ibu.
l-m-e4-b01-29.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na 6+4=10, ị ga-ede 0 ma buru 1. 3+0+1=4, ya mere nchikọta bụ 4.05.
l-m-e4-b01-29.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe ebe ndị ụzọ iri ruru 10, ị ga-ebu 1, ma ebughị ya, ya mere ③ adịghị mma. Site n'ibu, 3+0+1=4.
l-m-e4-b01-29.s.s2.model.1: E hapụrụ ibu 1 n'③, ya mere ebe ndị otu ghọrọ 3. Ịgbakwunye ibu 1 na-enye 4.05.

l-m-e4-b01-37.title: Ebe njehie dị n'ịchọta akụkụ nke fọdụrụ na triangle
l-m-e4-b01-37.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta nke ịchọta akụkụ nke fọdụrụ na triangle, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, n'usoro; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ njehie mere.
l-m-e4-b01-37.material: Akụkụ abụọ nke triangle bụ 40° na 75°. A chọtara akụkụ nke fọdụrụ otu a. ① Nchikọta akụkụ atọ bụ 360° ② 40°+75°=115° ③ 360°−115°=245° ④ Akụkụ nke fọdụrụ bụ 245°
l-m-e4-b01-37.s.s1.o.a: ① Nzọụkwụ kpebiri nchikọta akụkụ atọ
l-m-e4-b01-37.s.s1.o.b: ② Nzọụkwụ gbakwunyere akụkụ abụọ ahụ
l-m-e4-b01-37.s.s1.o.c: ③ Nzọụkwụ wepụrụ na nchikọta ahụ
l-m-e4-b01-37.s.s1.r.c: Ngụkọta 360−115=245 ziri ezi. Njehie ahụ dị tupu ya.
l-m-e4-b01-37.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ nsonaazụ nke iso njehie dị na ①.
l-m-e4-b01-37.s.s1.explain: Nchikọta akụkụ atọ nke triangle bụ 180°. 180°−115°=65° bụ akụkụ nke fọdụrụ.
l-m-e4-b01-37.s.s2.model.0: Nchikọta akụkụ atọ nke triangle bụ 180°, ọ bụghị 360°, ya mere ① bụ njehie mbụ. 180°−115°=65°.
l-m-e4-b01-37.s.s2.model.1: 360° bụ nchikọta akụkụ anọ nke quadrilateral, ya mere e kwesịghị iji ya maka triangle. Idozi ya ka ọ bụrụ 180° na-enye 65°.

l-m-e4-b02-13.title: Aṣiṣe akọkọ ni yanju 756÷12
l-m-e4-b02-13.goal: Tẹle awọn igbesẹ ojutu 756÷12, tabi ọna asopọ idi ati abajade, lati wa ibi akọkọ ti o ti ṣe aṣiṣe ki o ṣe atunṣe.
l-m-e4-b02-13.material: Eyi ni bi a ṣe yanju 756÷12. ① Pin 75 nipasẹ 12 lati gba ipin 6 ② Kọ ipin 6 si ipo ọkan ③ 12×6=72, 75−72=3 ④ Mu 6 sọkalẹ ki o kọ 36÷12=3 si ipo mẹwa; nitorina ipin jẹ 36
l-m-e4-b02-13.s.s1.o.b: ② Ibi ti a kọ ipin 6 si
l-m-e4-b02-13.s.s1.o.d: ④ Igbesẹ gbigbe 6 sọkalẹ ati pipin
l-m-e4-b02-13.s.s1.r.d: Eyi jẹ abajade ti tẹle ibi ti o ti ṣe aṣiṣe ni ②.
l-m-e4-b02-13.s.s1.explain: A pin 75 titi de ipo mẹwa, nitorina a kọ ipin 6 si ipo mẹwa. Ipin jẹ 63.
l-m-e4-b02-13.s.s2.model.0: Nigbati o ba n pin 75, ipin naa wa ni ipo mẹwa; nitorina o yẹ ki a kọ 6 si ipo mẹwa, ṣugbọn a kọ ọ si ipo ọkan. Eyi ni idi ti ② ko tọ.
l-m-e4-b02-13.s.s2.model.1: Nitori ipo ipin ti ṣeto ni aṣiṣe ni ②, 3 gbe si ipo mẹwa o si di 36. Ti a ba kọ 6 si ipo mẹwa, o jẹ 63.

l-m-e4-b02-21.title: Njehie mbụ dị na nkọwa gbasara ahịrị ndị yiri ibe ha
l-m-e4-b02-21.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta gbasara mmekọrịta ahịrị A, B, na C, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ebe mbụ o mejọrọ, ma dozie ya.
l-m-e4-b02-21.material: A kọwara mmekọrịta mgbe ahịrị A na B abụọ kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ ahịrị C otu a. ① A kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ C ② B kwụkwara ọtọ n'akụkụ C ③ Ha kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ otu ahịrị, ya mere A na B kwụkwara ọtọ n'akụkụ ibe ha ④ A na B kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ ibe ha
l-m-e4-b02-21.s.s1.o.a: ① Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti A na C
l-m-e4-b02-21.s.s1.r.a: Na e nyere na A kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ C bụ ọnọdụ e kwuru.
l-m-e4-b02-21.s.s1.o.b: ② Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti B na C
l-m-e4-b02-21.s.s1.r.b: Na e nyere na B kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ C bụkwa ọnọdụ e kwuru.
l-m-e4-b02-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ Nzọụkwụ kwuru mmekọrịta dị n'etiti A na B
l-m-e4-b02-21.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ nsonaazụ iso njehie dị na ③.
l-m-e4-b02-21.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị abụọ kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ otu ahịrị bụ ahịrị parallel ndị na-adịghị ezute.
l-m-e4-b02-21.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrị abụọ kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ otu ahịrị bụ parallel, ha anaghị akwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ ibe ha. Ya mere ③ bụ njehie mbụ.
l-m-e4-b02-21.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na A na B kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ ibe ha, ha ga-ezute. Ma ha abụọ kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ C, ya mere ha anaghị ezute. Dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ parallel.

l-m-e4-b02-29.title: Aṣiṣe akọkọ ni iyokuro nọmba adalu
l-m-e4-b02-29.goal: Tẹle awọn igbesẹ ojutu fun yiyọ 1 ati 5/6 kuro ninu 4 ati 1/6, tabi ọna idi ati abajade, wa ibi akọkọ ti aṣiṣe ki o ṣe atunṣe.
l-m-e4-b02-29.material: A yọ 1 ati 5/6 kuro ninu 4 ati 1/6 bayii. ① A ko le yọ 5/6 kuro ninu 1/6 ② Ya 1 lati 4, yi i pada si 3 ati 6/6 ③ 6/6−5/6=1/6, 3−1=2 ④ Idahun jẹ 2 ati 1/6
l-m-e4-b02-29.s.s1.o.a: ① Igbesẹ ti pinnu pe a ko le yọ
l-m-e4-b02-29.s.s1.r.a: O tọ nitori 1/6 kere ju 5/6 lọ.
l-m-e4-b02-29.s.s1.r.c: Iṣiro iyokuro lati 3 ati 6/6 funra rẹ tọ.
l-m-e4-b02-29.s.s1.r.d: Eyi ni abajade ti aṣiṣe ninu ②.
l-m-e4-b02-29.s.s1.explain: 1 ti a ya jẹ 6/6, ida 1/6 atilẹba si wa sibẹ; nitorina o jẹ 3 ati 7/6. 7/6−5/6=2/6; idahun jẹ 2 ati 2/6.
l-m-e4-b02-29.s.s2.model.0: 1 ti a ya jẹ 6/6, 1/6 atilẹba naa ṣi wa, nitorina o yẹ ki o jẹ 3 ati 7/6; ② ko tọ.
l-m-e4-b02-29.s.s2.model.1: Ninu ②, a fo 1/6 silẹ, o di 3 ati 6/6. Ti a ba ṣe atunṣe si 3 ati 7/6, idahun jẹ 2 ati 2/6.

l-m-e4-b02-37.title: Na-enyocha ngwọta maka ịchọta nọmba nke 20
l-m-e4-b02-37.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ngwọta iji chọta nọmba nke 20 n'usoro 5, 9, 13, 17..., chọta ebe mbụ ihe na-aga na-ezighi ezi, ma dozie ya.
l-m-e4-b02-37.material: A chọtara nọmba nke 20 n'usoro 5, 9, 13, 17... otu a. ① Ọdịiche dị n'etiti nọmba ndị agbata obi bụ 4 mgbe niile ② Tinye 4 ugboro 20 na nọmba mbụ 5 ③ 5+4×20=85 ④ Nọmba nke 20 bụ 85
l-m-e4-b02-37.s.s1.o.a: ① Nzọụkwụ nke kpebiri na ọdịiche bụ otu mgbe niile
l-m-e4-b02-37.s.s1.r.a: 9−5, 13−9, na 17−13 bụ 4 niile, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b02-37.s.s1.o.b: ② Nzọụkwụ kwuru ka a tinye 4 ugboro 20
l-m-e4-b02-37.s.s1.explain: Site na nọmba mbụ ruo na nke 20, tinye 4 ugboro 19. 5+4×19=81 bụ nọmba nke 20.
l-m-e4-b02-37.s.s2.model.0: Nọmba mbụ bụ nke 1, ya mere iji ruo na nke 20, tinye 4 naanị ugboro 19; nke a na-eme ka ② bụrụ ihe na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-e4-b02-37.s.s2.model.1: 5 bụ nọmba nke 1, ya mere 5+4×19=81, nke bụ ịgbakwunye 4 ugboro 19, bụ nọmba nke 20.

l-m-e4-b03-05.title: Mmejọ mbụ mgbe a na-atụnyere nọmba buru ibu abụọ
l-m-e4-b03-05.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ngwọta iji tụnyere 3456789 na 3457012, chọta ebe mbụ ihe na-aga na-ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-m-e4-b03-05.material: E jiri ụzọ a tụnyere 3456789 na 3457012. ① Nọmba abụọ ahụ nwere mkpụrụọnụọgụ asaa ② Tụnyere malite n'ebe otu ③ 9 karịrị 2, ya mere 3456789 ka ukwuu ④ Nọmba ka ukwuu bụ 3456789
l-m-e4-b03-05.s.s1.r.a: Ọ ziri ezi na nọmba abụọ ahụ nwere mkpụrụọnụọgụ asaa.

l-m-e4-b03-05.s.s1.r.c: 9 karịrị 2, ma ebe e ji atụnyere ezighị ezi.
l-m-e4-b03-05.s.s1.o.d: ④ Nzọụkwụ ikpebi nọmba ka ukwuu
l-m-e4-b03-05.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ mkpụrụọnụọgụ hà nhata, tulee malite n'ebe kachasị elu. N'ebe puku 6<7, ya mere 3457012 ka ukwuu.

l-m-e4-b03-05.s.s2.model.1: N'ebe puku e nwere 6 na 7, ya mere 3457012 ka ukwuu. Ebe ndị dị ala 9 na 2 enweghị ike ikpebi oke ahụ.

l-m-e4-b03-13.title: Ebe ngwọta 100÷7 malitere imehie
l-m-e4-b03-13.goal: Soro ngwọta 100÷7, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, n'usoro; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o mejọrọ.
l-m-e4-b03-13.material: E doziri 100÷7 otu a. ① 7×13=91 ② 100−91=9 ③ E dere 9 dịka ihe fọdụrụ ④ 100÷7=13…9
l-m-e4-b03-13.s.s1.o.c: ③ Nzọụkwụ ide 9 dịka ihe fọdụrụ
l-m-e4-b03-13.s.s1.explain: Ihe fọdụrụ ga-adị obere karịa divisor 7. 9 karịrị 7, ya mere ọ bụrụ na i gbanwee quotient ka ọ bụrụ 14, ihe fọdụrụ bụ 2.
l-m-e4-b03-13.s.s2.model.0: Ihe fọdụrụ ga-adị obere karịa divisor, ma 9 karịrị 7. Ya mere ③ ezighị ezi. Ọ bụrụ na i gbanwee quotient ka ọ bụrụ 14, ihe fọdụrụ bụ 2.
l-m-e4-b03-13.s.s2.model.1: 7 ga-abanye na 9 otu ugboro ọzọ, ya mere quotient na-abụ 14, a ga-edozikwa ihe fọdụrụ ka ọ bụrụ 9−7=2.

l-m-e4-b03-21.title: Ebe ngwọta banyere akụkụ dị n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ hiere ụzọ
l-m-e4-b03-21.goal: Soro ngwọta ịchọta akụkụ fọdụrụ n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, nzọụkwụ n'ụzọ nzọụkwụ iji chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere.
l-m-e4-b03-21.material: N'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, mgbe otu akụkụ bụ 125°, a chọtara akụkụ dị ya nso otu a. ① Akụkụ ahịrị kwụ ọtọ bụ 180° ② 125°+□=180° ③ □=180°+125°=305° ④ Akụkụ dị nso bụ 305°
l-m-e4-b03-21.s.s1.o.a: ① Nzọụkwụ ikpebi akụkụ ahịrị kwụ ọtọ
l-m-e4-b03-21.s.s1.r.a: Akụkụ ahịrị kwụ ọtọ bụ 180°, nke ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b03-21.s.s1.explain: □=180°−125°=55°. N'ọrụ mgbakwunye, a na-achọta nọmba amaghị ama site n'iwepụ.
l-m-e4-b03-21.s.s2.model.0: Na 125°+□=180°, ị ga-ewepụ 125° na 180° iji chọta □, ma a gbakwụnyere ya; ya mere ③ ezighị ezi. Azịza ya bụ 55°.
l-m-e4-b03-21.s.s2.model.1: Na ③ ị ga-eji mwepụ kama mgbakwunye; ya mere dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ 180°−125°=55°.

l-m-e4-b04-21.title: Mmejọ dị na mwepụ nnukwu nọmba
l-m-e4-b04-21.goal: Soro ngwọta 52,300−37,800 nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu, chọta ebe mbụ ihe na-aga na-ezighi ezi, ma dozie ya.
l-m-e4-b04-21.material: Ntụgharị 52,300−37,800: ① Ebe otu na iri: 0−0=0 ② N'ebe narị, a pụghị iwepụ 8 na 3, ya mere 8−3=5 ③ N'ebe puku, 2−7 bụkwa 7−2=5 ④ Ebe iri puku: 5−3=2, ya mere azịza bụ 25,500. Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-e4-b04-21.s.s1.r.c: ③ bụ ahịrị na-aga n'ihu na otu mmejọ ②. Ọ bụghị nke mbụ.
l-m-e4-b04-21.s.s1.r.d: 5−3=2 n'onwe ya ziri ezi, ma mmejọ gara aga metụtara ya.
l-m-e4-b04-21.s.s1.explain: Mgbe i nweghị ike iwepụ nnukwu nọmba na obere, gbaziri 10 site n'ebe ọzọ dị elu. 13−8=5, 11−7=4, 4−3=1, ya mere azịza bụ 14,500.
l-m-e4-b04-21.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe 3 dị obere karịa 8, i kwesịghị ịtụgharị mwepụ dịka 8−3. Ị ga-agbazite n'ebe ọzọ dị elu, ya mere ② ezighị ezi.
l-m-e4-b04-21.s.s2.model.1: Iwepụ obere nọmba na nnukwu na ② bụ mmejọ mbụ, ya mere gbaziri dịka 13−8=5 ma dozie azịza ka ọ bụrụ 14,500.

l-m-e4-b04-22.title: Ebee ka mmejọ dị na ngwọta 275÷25?
l-m-e4-b04-22.goal: Soro ngwọta ịchọta 275÷25 dịka azịza na ihe fọdụrụ, chọta ebe mbụ ihe na-aga na-ezighi ezi, ma dozie ya.
l-m-e4-b04-22.material: Ntụgharị 275÷25: ① 25×10=250 ② 275−250=25 ③ 25 bụ ihe fọdụrụ, ya mere azịza bụ 10, ihe fọdụrụ 25 ④ Nyochaa: 25×10+25=275. Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi.

l-m-e4-b04-22.s.s1.explain: Ihe fọdụrụ ga-adị obere karịa onye nkewa, 25. Ebe 25 fọdụrụ, kewaa otu ugboro ọzọ iji nweta azịza 11 na ihe fọdụrụ 0.
l-m-e4-b04-22.s.s2.model.0: Ihe fọdụrụ 25 hà nhata onye nkewa 25, ya mere a pụrụ ịga n'ihu kee ya; nke a mere ③ ji ezighị ezi. Dozie azịza ka ọ bụrụ 11.

l-m-e4-b04-23.title: Mmejọ n'ịgụ eserese ogwe
l-m-e4-b04-23.goal: Soro ngwọta ịgụ ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ site n'eserese ogwe, chọta ebe mbụ ihe na-aga na-ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-m-e4-b04-23.material: Nzọụkwụ otu na akpịrịkpa kwụ ọtọ nke eserese ogwe bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ 2. Ogwe ụmụ akwụkwọ hụrụ strawberries n'anya dị nzọụkwụ 6. Ntụgharị: ① Otu nzọụkwụ bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ 2 ② Ogwe ahụ bụ nzọụkwụ 6 ③ Ọnụọgụ nzọụkwụ bụ 6, ya mere ụmụ akwụkwọ 6 ④ Ụmụ akwụkwọ 6 hụrụ strawberries n'anya. Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-e4-b04-23.s.s1.o.a: ① Otu nzọụkwụ bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ 2
l-m-e4-b04-23.s.s1.r.a: Ajụjụ ahụ kwuru na otu nzọụkwụ bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ 2.
l-m-e4-b04-23.s.s1.r.b: O kwuru na ịdị elu ogwe ahụ bụ nzọụkwụ 6.
l-m-e4-b04-23.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ọnụọgụ nzọụkwụ bụ 6, ya mere ụmụ akwụkwọ 6
l-m-e4-b04-23.s.s1.o.d: ④ Ụmụ akwụkwọ 6 hụrụ strawberries n'anya
l-m-e4-b04-23.s.s1.r.d: ④ ketara uru na-ezighi ezi nke ③.
l-m-e4-b04-23.s.s1.explain: Otu nzọụkwụ bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ 2, ya mere nzọụkwụ 6 bụ 2×6=12 ụmụ akwụkwọ. E kwesịghị ide ọnụọgụ nzọụkwụ dịka ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.
l-m-e4-b04-23.s.s2.model.0: Otu nzọụkwụ bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ 2, ya mere nzọụkwụ 6 ga-abụ 2×6=12 ụmụ akwụkwọ. Ọ bụ ya mere ③, nke jiri ọnụọgụ nzọụkwụ ahụ n'onwe ya, ji ezighị ezi.

l-m-e4-b04-24.s.s1.r.d: ④ ketara uru na-ezighi ezi nke ③.
l-m-e4-b04-24.title: Na-enyocha ngwọta maka akụkụ ntọala nke triangle nwere akụkụ abụọ hà nhata
l-m-e4-b04-24.goal: Soro usoro ịchọta akụkụ ntọala nke triangle nwere akụkụ abụọ hà nhata, chọta ebe mbụ ihe na-aga na-ezighi ezi, ma dozie ya.
l-m-e4-b04-24.material: Ntụgharị akụkụ ntọala triangle nwere akụkụ abụọ hà nhata nke akụkụ elu ya bụ 30°: ① Ngụkọta akụkụ atọ bụ 180° ② 180°−30°=150° ③ Akụkụ ntọala abụọ hà nhata, ya mere otu akụkụ ntọala bụ 150° ④ Akụkụ ntọala bụ 150°. Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-e4-b04-24.s.s1.r.a: Ọ ziri ezi na ngụkọta akụkụ atọ nke triangle bụ 180°.
l-m-e4-b04-24.s.s1.explain: 150° bụ ngụkọta akụkụ ntọala abụọ. Akụkụ ntọala abụọ hà nhata, ya mere otu akụkụ ntọala bụ 150°÷2=75°.
l-m-e4-b04-24.s.s2.model.0: 150° bụ ngụkọta akụkụ ntọala abụọ, ya mere a ga-ekewa ya abụọ, 75° nke ọ bụla; nke a mere ③ ji ezighị ezi.
l-m-e4-b04-24.s.s2.model.1: 75°+75°+30°=180°, ya mere akụkụ ntọala bụ 75°, 150° ezighị ezi.

l-m-e4-b04-25.title: Ebee ka mmejọ mbụ dị na nkọwa eserese ahụ?
l-m-e4-b04-25.goal: Tẹle alaye nipa kika aworan laini, tabi ọna idi ati abajade, ni igbese kọọkan; wa ibi akọkọ ti aṣiṣe ki o ṣe atunṣe.
l-m-e4-b04-25.material: Iwọn otutu ti a wọn ni gbogbo wakati: agogo 1 12°, agogo 2 14°, agogo 3 19°, agogo 4 17°. Alaye: ① Igbega nla julọ wa lati agogo 2 si 3 (5°) ② Iwọn otutu giga julọ jẹ 19° ni agogo 3 ③ Iwọn otutu kekere julọ jẹ 17° ni agogo 4. Wa ibi akọkọ ti ko tọ.
l-m-e4-b04-25.s.s1.o.a: ① O pọ si ni 5° lati agogo 2 si 3
l-m-e4-b04-25.s.s1.r.a: O lọ lati 14 si 19, igbega 5°; alaye yii tọ.
l-m-e4-b04-25.s.s1.o.b: ② Iwọn otutu giga julọ jẹ 19°
l-m-e4-b04-25.s.s1.r.b: 19° ni iye giga julọ, nitorina alaye yii tọ.
l-m-e4-b04-25.s.s1.o.c: ③ Iwọn otutu kekere julọ jẹ 17°
l-m-e4-b04-25.s.s1.r.d: 12° ni agogo 1 kere ju; nitorina ③ ko tọ.
l-m-e4-b04-25.s.s1.explain: Iwọn otutu kekere julọ jẹ 12° ni agogo 1. O lọ silẹ ni agogo 4, ṣugbọn 17° ga ju 12° lọ.
l-m-e4-b04-25.s.s2.model.0: 12° ni agogo 1 kere ju 17° ni agogo 4 lọ, nitorina ③ ko tọ; iwọn otutu kekere julọ jẹ 12°.
l-m-e4-b04-25.s.s2.model.1: Ninu aaye mẹrin lori aworan, iye kekere julọ jẹ 12°, nitorina ③ gbọdọ di 12°.

l-m-e4-b05-22.title: Ịlele ngwọta perimeta parallelogram
l-m-e4-b05-22.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, maka ịchọta perimeta parallelogram n'usoro; chọta ebe mbụ o mejọrọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-e4-b05-22.material: Ngwọta perimeta parallelogram nke akụkụ abụọ agbata obi ya bụ 8 cm na 5 cm: ① Akụkụ ndị na-emegide ibe ha hà nhata. ② Nchikọta akụkụ abụọ agbata obi bụ 8+5=13. ③ Perimeta bụ 13 cm. Chọta ahịrị mbụ ezighị ezi.
l-m-e4-b05-22.s.s1.o.a: ① Akụkụ ndị na-emegide ibe ha hà nhata
l-m-e4-b05-22.s.s1.r.a: Na parallelogram, akụkụ ndị na-emegide ibe ha hà nhata, ya mere nke a ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b05-22.s.s1.r.d: Ị ga-agbakwunye akụkụ anọ niile, ya mere ③ ezighị ezi.
l-m-e4-b05-22.s.s1.explain: Perimeta bụ nchikọta akụkụ anọ. Ọ bụ 26 cm, site n'ịgbakwunye 8, 5, 8, 5, ya mere ị ga-amụba 13 na 2.
l-m-e4-b05-22.s.s2.model.0: 13 bụ naanị nchikọta akụkụ abụọ, a chọrọ akụkụ anọ niile, ya mere ③ ezighị ezi. 13×2=26 cm.
l-m-e4-b05-22.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ ndị na-emegide ibe ha hà nhata, ya mere 8+5+8+5=26 cm; ma ③ gbakwụnyere naanị akụkụ abụọ, ya mere ezighị ezi.

l-m-e4-b05-24.material: Isiokwu kacha amasị: Korean ụmụ akwụkwọ 8, mgbakọ na mwepụ 12, egwuregwu mmega ahụ 15, nka 9. Nkọwa: ① A nyochara ụmụ akwụkwọ 44 n'ozuzu. ② Isiokwu ụmụ akwụkwọ kacha họrọ bụ egwuregwu mmega ahụ. ③ Ụmụ akwụkwọ họọrọ egwuregwu mmega ahụ karịrị ọkara nke mkpokọta. Chọta ebe mbụ ezighị ezi.

l-m-e4-b05-25.title: Ịlele ngwọta nke gbanwere nchikọta ụmụ irighiri ka ọ bụrụ mixed number
l-m-e4-b05-25.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, nke ngụkọta 5/9+7/9 n'usoro; chọta ebe mbụ o mejọrọ ma dozie ya.
l-m-e4-b05-25.material: Ngwọta 5/9+7/9: ① Denominator hà nhata, ya mere denominator na-anọ 9. ② Gbakwunye numerator: 5+7=12. ③ Maka 12/9, wepụta ọnụọgụ zuru ezu 1 ma dee ya dịka 1 na 12/9. ④ Azịza bụ 1 na 12/9. Chọta ahịrị mbụ ezighị ezi.
l-m-e4-b05-25.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe denominator hà nhata, ọ ziri ezi ịhapụ ya otu ọ dị.
l-m-e4-b05-25.s.s1.r.d: ④ bụ nsonaazụ sitere na mkpụrụokwu ngụkọta na-ezighị ezi dị na ③.
l-m-e4-b05-25.s.s1.explain: Iwepụta 1 (=9/9) na 12/9 na-ahapụ numerator 12−9=3. Ya mere azịza bụ 1 na 3/9.
l-m-e4-b05-25.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe i wepụtara 1, ị ga-ewepụ 9 na numerator 12. Ya mere 12/9 na-abụ 1 na 3/9, ma ③ hapụrụ 12 n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-e4-b05-25.s.s2.model.1: 1 na 12/9 bụ ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu nke na-agbakwunye 12/9 na 1 ọzọ, ya mere ọ dị iche na 5/9+7/9=12/9. Dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ 1 na 3/9.

l-m-e4-b01-06.topic: Ide nnukwu nọmba site na mkpụrụọnụọgụ
l-m-e4-b01-06.goal: Gbanwee 3 eok 5 puku man gaa n'ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-e4-b01-06.material: E dere ire ụlọ ọrụ kwa afọ dịka “3 eok 5 puku man won”. (1 man = 10,000; 1 eok = 100,000,000) Ị chọrọ iji mkpụrụọnụọgụ naanị degharịa ya.

l-m-e4-b01-06.s.s1.r.b: O nweghị 0 otu. Ọ bụ 3500 man.
l-m-e4-b01-06.s.s1.r.c: O nwere 0 ọzọ. Ọ bụ 35 eok.
l-m-e4-b01-06.s.s1.explain: 3 eok bụ 300000000, 5 puku man bụ 50000000, ya mere ha jikọtara bụrụ 350000000.
l-m-e4-b01-06.s.s2.model.0: 3 eok bụ 300000000, 5 puku man bụ 50000000, ya mere ịgbakwunye ha na-enye 350000000.
l-m-e4-b01-06.s.s2.model.1: E nwere 3 n'ebe narị nde, 5 n'ebe iri nde, 0 n'ebe ndị ọzọ niile, ya mere ọ bụ 350000000.

l-m-e4-b01-38.s.s1.r.d: Ị nweghị ike iwepụ ihe na 65 ka i nweta 180.
l-m-e4-b01-38.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị kwụ ọtọ bụ 180°, ya mere nchikọta akụkụ abụọ ahụ bụ 180°. □ bụ 115.

l-m-e4-b02-22.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na naanị akụkụ ndị na-emegide ibe ha hà nhata, ọ nwere ike ghara inwe akụkụ ziri ezi.

l-m-e4-b04-26.title: Sísọ 180° ni iye awọn igun ọtun
l-m-e4-b04-26.goal: Yi igun laini taara, 180°, pada si ọna ifihan miiran (idogba, tabili, aworan, ọrọ) ki o ṣalaye idi ti itumọ kanna.
l-m-e4-b04-26.material: Igun ti laini taara ṣe jẹ 180°. A mọ pe igun ọtun jẹ 90°; a fẹ sọ 180° gẹgẹ bi iye igun ọtun.
l-m-e4-b04-26.s.s1.prompt: Gbólóhùn wo ni o fihan iwọn kanna bi 180°?
l-m-e4-b04-26.s.s1.explain: Igun ọtun 1 jẹ 90°, nitorina 90°+90°=180°. Eyi jẹ kanna pẹlu igun ọtun 2.
l-m-e4-b04-26.s.s2.model.0: Igun ọtun 1 jẹ 90°, 90°+90°=180°; nitorina 180° jẹ kanna pẹlu igun ọtun 2.
l-m-e4-b04-26.s.s2.model.1: Nigbati o ba fi igun ọtun meji si ẹgbẹ, wọn ṣe laini taara; nitorina 180° jẹ igun ọtun 2.

l-m-e4-b04-27.title: Yiyipada itan sisopọ okun si idogba
l-m-e4-b04-27.goal: Yi gigun okun meji ti a so pọ pada si ọna ifihan miiran (idogba, tabili, aworan, ọrọ) ki o ṣalaye idi ti itumọ kanna.
l-m-e4-b04-27.material: A fẹ mọ apapọ m nigbati a so okun pupa gigun 1.4 m ati okun buluu gigun 0.75 m pọ ni ila kan. Yi itan yii pada si idogba.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.prompt: Idogba wo ni o ba itan naa mu?
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.r.a: Sisopọ mu gigun pọ si, nitorina kii ṣe iyokuro.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.r.b: Gigun ti a so pọ jẹ apapọ, kii ṣe isodipupo.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.r.d: A da 0.75 kọ gẹgẹ bi 7.5 ni aṣiṣe. Aaye eleemewa wa ni ibi miiran.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.explain: Nigbati a ba so okun meji pọ, a ṣafikun gigun wọn. 1.4+0.75=2.15, nitorina o jẹ 2.15 m.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s2.model.0: Sisopọ okun mu gigun wọn di apapọ, nitorina a le kọ 1.4+0.75.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s2.model.1: A fi 0.75 m kun gigun akọkọ 1.4 m; nitorina idogba afikun 1.4+0.75 ni itumọ kanna pẹlu itan naa.

l-m-e4-b04-28.title: Sísọ “perpendicular” ni awọn ọrọ miiran
l-m-e4-b04-28.goal: Yi gbolohun “awọn laini taara meji wa ni perpendicular si ara wọn” pada si ọna ifihan miiran (idogba, tabili, aworan, ọrọ) ki o ṣalaye idi ti itumọ kanna.
l-m-e4-b04-28.material: Laini A ati laini B jẹ perpendicular si ara wọn. A fẹ tun sọ eyi ni awọn ọrọ miiran ti o ni itumọ kanna.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.prompt: Gbólóhùn wo ni o ni itumọ kanna?
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.o.a: Awọn laini meji pade wọn si ṣe igun ọtun
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.o.b: Awọn laini meji pade wọn si ṣe igun obtuse
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.r.b: Wọn gbọdọ ṣe igun ọtun, kii ṣe obtuse, lati jẹ perpendicular.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.r.c: Awọn laini ti ko pade jẹ parallel. Wọn kii ṣe perpendicular.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.o.d: Awọn laini meji ni gigun kanna
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.r.d: Laini taara ko ni gigun ti a ti pinnu, gigun ko si ni ibatan si perpendicular.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.explain: Nigbati igun ti awọn laini meji ti o pade ba jẹ igun ọtun, a sọ pe wọn jẹ perpendicular si ara wọn.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s2.model.0: “Perpendicular” tumọ si pe igun ti awọn laini meji ti o pade ṣe jẹ igun ọtun; itumọ kanna ni “pade ki o ṣe igun ọtun”.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s2.model.1: Awọn laini meji pade ni aaye kan, igun naa jẹ 90°; eyi tun tumọ si perpendicular.

l-m-e4-b04-29.material: A fẹ mọ apoti melo ni a nilo ti a ba fi marbles 120 sinu apoti, marbles 15 ninu apoti kọọkan. Jẹ ki nọmba apoti jẹ □ ki o yi itan pada si idogba.
l-m-e4-b04-29.s.s1.r.a: A paarọ olupin ati nọmba ti a pin.
l-m-e4-b04-29.s.s1.r.b: Fifi kun fun apapọ marbles, kii ṣe nọmba apoti.

l-m-e4-b04-29.s.s2.model.0: A pin gbogbo 120 si ẹgbẹ 15, nitorina kọ 120÷15=□.
l-m-e4-b04-29.s.s2.model.1: Lapapọ marbles ni nọmba ti a pin; 15 ninu apoti kan ni olupin; nitorina 120÷15=□.

l-m-e4-b04-30.title: Sísọ “equilateral triangle” gẹgẹ bi igun
l-m-e4-b04-30.goal: Yi “onigun mẹta ti gbogbo ẹgbẹ mẹta rẹ ni gigun kanna” pada si ọna ifihan miiran (idogba, tabili, aworan, ọrọ) ki o ṣalaye idi ti itumọ kanna.
l-m-e4-b04-30.material: Onigun mẹta ti gbogbo ẹgbẹ rẹ ni gigun kanna jẹ equilateral triangle. A fẹ sọ eyi gẹgẹ bi titobi igun dipo ẹgbẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.prompt: Gbólóhùn wo ni o sọ apejuwe equilateral triangle gẹgẹ bi igun?
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.r.b: Apapọ igun mẹta jẹ 180°, nitorina wọn ko le jẹ 90° ọkọọkan.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.r.c: Ti igun ọtun ba wa, awọn ẹgbẹ ko le jẹ gbogbo wọn dogba.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.r.d: Ninu equilateral triangle, gbogbo igun mẹta dọgba, kii ṣe meji nikan.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.explain: Ti gbogbo ẹgbẹ mẹta ba dọgba, gbogbo igun mẹta naa dọgba; apapọ wọn jẹ 180°, nitorina igun kọọkan jẹ 180°÷3=60°.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s2.model.0: Ti ẹgbẹ mẹta ba dọgba, igun mẹta dọgba, apapọ wọn jẹ 180°; nitorina igun kọọkan jẹ 60°.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s2.model.1: Equilateral triangle gbọdọ ni igun mẹta dọgba; itumọ kanna ni onigun mẹta ti igun kọọkan jẹ 180°÷3=60°.

l-m-e4-b05-26.title: Ikwu ntụgharị gaa n'aka nri n'ụzọ ọzọ
l-m-e4-b05-26.goal: Kwuo n'ụzọ ọzọ ọdịdị e nwetara site n'ịtụgharị ọdịdị gaa n'aka nri (mkpụrụokwu ngụkọta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere o ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-e4-b05-26.material: E tụgharịrị ọdịdị gaa n'aka nri. Ị chọrọ iji okwu chọta mmegharị ọzọ na-enye otu nsonaazụ ahụ.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu mmegharị na-enye otu ọdịdị ahụ dịka ntụgharị gaa n'aka nri?
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.r.b: Ịtụgharị na-agbanwe ntụziaka ọdịdị ahụ, ya mere ọ dị iche na ọdịdị e tụgharịrị.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.r.c: Ịtụgharị elu na-agbanwe elu na ala, ya mere ọ dị iche na ọdịdị nke agbanwere aka ekpe na aka nri.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.r.d: Ịkwaga anaghị agbanwe aka ekpe na aka nri nke ọdịdị ahụ.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.explain: Ma i tụgharịa gaa n'aka nri ma ọ bụ aka ekpe, ị ga-enweta ọdịdị agbanwere aka ekpe na aka nri.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s2.model.0: Abụọ ahụ gbanwere aka nri na aka ekpe, ya mere ha bụ otu.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s2.model.1: N'akụkụ ọ bụla a tụgharịrị, aka ekpe na aka nri na-agbanwe, ya mere ọ bụ otu ihe na ịtụgharị n'aka ekpe.

l-m-e4-b05-27.title: Iji degharịa mmiri 1/2 L a wụsara ugboro 3
l-m-e4-b05-27.goal: Jiri ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese ma ọ bụ okwu) degharịa mmiri a wụsara ugboro 3 site n'iji iko 1/2 L, kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-e4-b05-27.material: Eji iko 1/2 L wụsa mmiri n'ime ite ugboro 3. Dee mmiri ahụ dịka 1/2+1/2+1/2, gosikwa ya dịka nọmba agwakọtara.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke gosiri otu mmiri ahụ?
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ uru e dere nọmba dum 3 na 1/2 ọnụ.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s1.r.b: Nke a dị obere karịa 1/2. Ịgbakwunye ya ugboro 3 gafere 1 L.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s1.r.c: Nke a na-agbakwụnyekwa denominator. Denominator na-anọgide 2.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe denominator irighiri ihe hà nhata, a na-agbakwunye numerator naanị, ya mere ọ bụ 3/2, 3/2=1 na 1/2.
l-m-e4-b05-27.s.s2.model.1: Ịwụsa 1/2 L ugboro abụọ na-eme 1 L, ịwụsa otu ugboro ọzọ na-eme 1 na 1/2 L.

l-m-e4-b05-29.title: Iji okwu degharịa tebụl
l-m-e4-b05-29.goal: Jiri ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese ma ọ bụ okwu) degharịa tebụl ọnụ ọgụgụ akwụkwọ e weghachiri n'ụbọchị izu, kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-e4-b05-29.material: Ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ e weghachiri kwa ụbọchị: Mọnde akwụkwọ 4, Tuzdee akwụkwọ 7, Wenezdee akwụkwọ 7, Tọzdee akwụkwọ 11. Ị chọrọ iji okwu degharịa ihe tebụl a na-ekwu.
l-m-e4-b05-29.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrịokwu nwere otu ihe tebụl ahụ na-ekwu?
l-m-e4-b05-29.s.s1.o.a: Ụbọchị e weghachiri akwụkwọ kacha nta bụ Wenezdee
l-m-e4-b05-29.s.s1.r.b: Tuzdee na Wenezdee bụ otu, akwụkwọ 7.
l-m-e4-b05-29.s.s1.r.c: Okpukpu 2 nke Tuzdee bụ akwụkwọ 14, ma Tọzdee bụ akwụkwọ 11.
l-m-e4-b05-29.s.s1.explain: 11−4=7, ya mere Tọzdee nwere akwụkwọ 7 karịa Mọnde. Ahịrịokwu ndị ọzọ dị iche na tebụl.
l-m-e4-b05-29.s.s2.model.0: Iwepụ akwụkwọ 4 nke Mọnde na akwụkwọ 11 nke Tọzdee na-enye akwụkwọ 7, ya mere ọ pụtara otu ihe na tebụl.
l-m-e4-b05-29.s.s2.model.1: Tuzdee na Wenezdee bụ otu, ụbọchị kacha nta bụ Mọnde, ya mere ahịrịokwu ndị ọzọ adịghị ka tebụl.

l-m-e4-b05-30.title: Iji tebụl degharịa eserese ogwe
l-m-e4-b05-30.material: E nwere eserese ogwe ebe otu oghere akpịrịkpa na-anọchi anya akwụkwọ 3. Ogwe A, B, C, D dị elu oghere 4, 6, 5, 2. Jiri ọnụ ọgụgụ akwụkwọ degharịa eserese ahụ dịka tebụl.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu tebụl gosiri otu ihe ahụ dịka eserese? (n'usoro A, B, C, D)
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s1.r.a: E dere ọnụ ọgụgụ oghere dịka ọnụ ọgụgụ akwụkwọ. Otu oghere bụ akwụkwọ 3.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s1.r.b: Agbakwunyere 3 na ọnụ ọgụgụ oghere. Ị ga-amụba site na 3.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-ewere otu oghere dịka akwụkwọ 4. Otu oghere bụ akwụkwọ 3.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s1.explain: Otu oghere bụ akwụkwọ 3, ya mere mụbaa ọnụ ọgụgụ oghere site na 3. 4×3=12, 6×3=18, 5×3=15, 2×3=6.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s2.model.0: Otu oghere bụ akwụkwọ 3, ya mere ịmụba ọnụ ọgụgụ oghere site na 3 na-enye akwụkwọ 12, 18, 15, 6, nke kwekọrọ na eserese.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ogwe dị oghere 4, nke ahụ bụ akwụkwọ 3 ugboro 4, ya bụ 12; ogwe ndị ọzọ bụkwa otu a, ya mere tebụl pụtara otu ihe na eserese.

l-m-e4-b01-07.material: Usoro A: Mkpụrụọnụọgụ mbụ bụ 9 na 1, ya mere 98765, nke nwere 9, ka ukwuu. Usoro B: Ịgụ mkpụrụọnụọgụ na-enye mkpụrụọnụọgụ 5 na mkpụrụọnụọgụ 6, ya mere 100234 ka ukwuu.
l-m-e4-b01-07.s.s1.prompt: Kedu n'ime ụzọ abụọ ahụ dabara adaba?
l-m-e4-b01-07.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe ọnụọgụ mkpụrụọnụọgụ dị iche, ọnụọgụ mkpụrụọnụọgụ ka mkpa karịa mkpụrụọnụọgụ mbụ.
l-m-e4-b01-07.s.s1.r.c: Nsonaazụ ha dị iche, ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịbụ eziokwu.
l-m-e4-b01-07.s.s1.r.d: Usoro B jiri ọnụọgụ mkpụrụọnụọgụ dịka ihe ndabere, ya mere ọ dabara adaba.
l-m-e4-b01-07.s.s1.explain: 98765 nwere mkpụrụọnụọgụ ise, 100234 nwekwara mkpụrụọnụọgụ isii. 100234, nke nwere mkpụrụọnụọgụ karịa, ka ukwuu.
l-m-e4-b01-07.s.s2.model.0: Nọmba nwere mkpụrụọnụọgụ karịa ka ukwuu, ya mere 100234, nke nwere mkpụrụọnụọgụ isii, karịrị 98765. Usoro B dabara adaba.
l-m-e4-b01-07.s.s2.model.1: 98765 erughị 10 man (100,000), 100234 karịrị 10 man, ya mere 100234 ka ukwuu. Usoro A leghaara ọnụọgụ mkpụrụọnụọgụ anya.

l-m-e4-b01-23.title: Ụzọ abụọ iji wepụ 1 and 2/5 site na 3
l-m-e4-b01-23.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka iwepụ 1 and 2/5 site na 3, họrọ nke kwesịrị ekwesị karị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-e4-b01-23.material: Ụzọ A: Gbanwee 3 ka ọ bụrụ 2 and 5/5, ya mere (2 and 5/5)−(1 and 2/5)=1 and 3/5. Ụzọ B: Wepụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu 3−1=2, wee jikọta akụkụ 2/5 dị ka o si dị ka ọ bụrụ 2 and 2/5.
l-m-e4-b01-23.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ bụ nke ziri ezi?
l-m-e4-b01-23.s.s1.r.b: Ị wepụrụ ọnụọgụ karịrị 1 site na 3, ya mere nsonaazụ ga-erịrị pere mpe karịa 2.
l-m-e4-b01-23.s.s1.r.c: Nsonaazụ ndị ahụ dị iche, ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịbụ ndị ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-23.s.s1.r.d: Ụzọ A mere ịgbazinye ahụ nke ọma.
l-m-e4-b01-23.s.s1.explain: Ọnụọgụ e wepụrụ site na 3 karịrị 1, ya mere nsonaazụ pere mpe karịa 2. 1 and 3/5 ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-23.s.s2.model.0: E wepụrụ ọnụọgụ karịrị 1 site na 3, ya mere azịza ga-erịrị pere mpe karịa 2. Ya mere Ụzọ B, nke na-enye 2 and 2/5, adịghị mma.
l-m-e4-b01-23.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbanwe 3 ka ọ bụrụ 2 and 5/5 na-enye 5/5−2/5=3/5 maka akụkụ na 2−1=1 maka ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, ya mere azịza bụ 1 and 3/5.

l-m-e4-b01-39.title: Ụzọ e si enyocha nchikọta akụkụ anọ nke quadrilateral

l-m-e4-b01-39.material: Ụzọ A: See otu diagonal n'ime quadrilateral iji kewaa ya ka ọ bụrụ triangle 2, ya mere 180°×2=360°. Ụzọ B: Were ya na akụkụ niile nke quadrilateral bụ akụkụ ziri ezi, ya mere 90°×4=360°.
l-m-e4-b01-39.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ a pụrụ iji maka quadrilateral niile?
l-m-e4-b01-39.s.s1.r.b: A pụghị iji ya maka quadrilateral nke akụkụ ya niile na-abụghị akụkụ ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-39.s.s1.r.c: Ụzọ B na-arụ ọrụ naanị n'ọnọdụ dịka rectangle.
l-m-e4-b01-39.s.s1.o.d: A pụghị iji nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b01-39.s.s1.r.d: A pụrụ iji Ụzọ A maka quadrilateral ọ bụla.
l-m-e4-b01-39.s.s1.explain: A pụrụ iji diagonal kewaa quadrilateral ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ triangle 2, ya mere 180°×2=360°.
l-m-e4-b01-39.s.s2.model.0: Diagonal otu na-eme ka quadrilateral ọ bụla bụrụ triangle 2. Ya mere a pụrụ iji Ụzọ A maka quadrilateral niile.
l-m-e4-b01-39.s.s2.model.1: Ụzọ B ziri ezi naanị mgbe akụkụ anọ niile bụ akụkụ ziri ezi. Ya mere a pụghị iji ya maka quadrilateral dịka parallelogram.

l-m-e4-b02-07.s.s2.model.1: Ọna A jinna ni 987, nitorina iṣiro Ọna B sunmọ nọmba gangan.

l-m-e4-b02-15.title: Ụzọ abụọ e si ngụkọta 49×6
l-m-e4-b02-15.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ maka ịchọta 49×6, họrọ nke dabara adaba karịa, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b02-15.material: Ụzọ A: 49 dị nso na 50, ya mere were 50×6=300 dịka azịza kpọmkwem. Ụzọ B: Site na 50×6=300, wepụ 1×6=6 ma dee 294.
l-m-e4-b02-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ dabara adaba iji chọta uru kpọmkwem?
l-m-e4-b02-15.s.s1.r.a: 50×6=300 bụ atụmatụ. Ọ dị iche na 49×6=294.
l-m-e4-b02-15.s.s1.r.c: Azịza ha dị iche, 300 na 294, ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịbụ eziokwu.
l-m-e4-b02-15.s.s1.o.d: Ọ dịghị nke ziri ezi kpọmkwem
l-m-e4-b02-15.s.s1.r.d: 294 nke Ụzọ B bụ uru kpọmkwem.
l-m-e4-b02-15.s.s1.explain: 49 pere mpe 1 karịa 50, ya mere 1 na-efu n'ime ugboro 6 ahụ, nke na-enye 300−6=294.
l-m-e4-b02-15.s.s2.model.0: 49 pere mpe 1 karịa 50, ya mere 1 na-efu n'otu n'otu n'ime ugboro 6 ahụ, nke na-enye 300−6=294. Ụzọ B bụ azịza kpọmkwem.
l-m-e4-b02-15.s.s2.model.1: 300 nke Ụzọ A bụ atụmatụ. Ya mere iji dee uru kpọmkwem, a ga-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ 294, ya bụ 50×6 ewepụrụ 6.

l-m-e4-b03-23.s.s1.r.c: Ụzọ A bụ ịkọ amụma n'anya, ya mere ọ naghị enye ezi nsonaazụ.

l-m-e4-b03-39.s.s1.explain: A bụ 150×60=9000 won B bụkwa 2000+100×60=8000 won, ya mere B dị ọnụ ala.
l-m-e4-b03-39.s.s2.model.0: B bụ 2000+6000=8000 won A bụkwa 9000 won, ya mere B dị ọnụ ala 1000 won.
l-m-e4-b03-39.s.s2.model.1: Ụgwọ B kwa nkeji 1 dị ọnụ ala, ọbụlagodi na ụgwọ isi 2000 won agbakwunyere, ngụkọta nke 8000 won dị ntakịrị karịa 9000 won, ya mere B ziri ezi.

l-m-e4-b04-31.material: A ṣe iṣiro 28×15 ni ọna meji. A: (30−2)×15=450−30=420. B: 28×(20−5)=560−100=460. Fi wọn we lati ri ọna ti o tọ.

l-m-e4-b04-31.s.s2.model.0: A gba 450−30=420; nitori 28×15=420, o tọ. B ṣe aṣiṣe 28×5 gẹgẹ bi 100.
l-m-e4-b04-31.s.s2.model.1: 28×5=140, ṣugbọn B yọ 100 o si gba 460; nitorina B ko tọ, A nikan ni o tọ.

l-m-e4-b05-31.material: A tụgharịrị kaadị akụkụ anọ nwere akara kpakpando n'akụkụ kachasị elu 90° n'aka elekere. Mmadụ abụọ kwuru ihe dị iche. A: Akụkụ nwere kpakpando na-aga n'aka nri. B: Akụkụ nwere kpakpando na-aga n'aka ekpe.
l-m-e4-b05-31.s.s1.r.b: Ịga n'aka ekpe na-eme mgbe a tụgharịrị n'akụkụ na-emegide elekere.

l-m-e4-b05-31.s.s1.r.d: Nkọwa A dabara na ịtụgharị n'aka elekere.
l-m-e4-b05-31.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ị tụgharịrị 90° n'aka elekere, akụkụ dị n'elu na-aga n'aka nri. Ọ bụ ntụgharị aka elekere site na 12 ruo 3.

l-m-e4-b05-32.title: Kedu nke dị ogologo, 1/4 m ma ọ bụ 1/5 m?
l-m-e4-b05-32.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ogologo 1/4 m ma ọ bụ 1/5 m, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b05-32.material: Tụlee otu iberibe eriri 1 m e kewara n'akụkụ hà nhata 4 (1/4 m) na otu iberibe nke e kewara n'akụkụ hà nhata 5 (1/5 m). A: Denominator 5 karịrị 4, ya mere 1/5 m dị ogologo. B: 1/4 m, ebe e kewara otu 1 m ahụ n'akụkụ ole na ole, dị ogologo.
l-m-e4-b05-32.s.s1.o.a: A: Denominator ka ukwuu, ya mere 1/5 m dị ogologo
l-m-e4-b05-32.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na i kee otu ogologo ahụ n'akụkụ karịa, iberibe nke ọ bụla ga-adị mkpụmkpụ.
l-m-e4-b05-32.s.s1.o.b: B: 1/4 m, nke e kewara n'akụkụ ole na ole, dị ogologo
l-m-e4-b05-32.s.s1.r.c: Nsonaazụ nkọwa abụọ ahụ dị iche, ya mere ha abụọ enweghị ike ịbụ eziokwu.
l-m-e4-b05-32.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ iberibe dị iche, ya mere ogologo ha dị iche.
l-m-e4-b05-32.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na i kee otu 1 m ahụ n'akụkụ hà nhata 4, iberibe nke ọ bụla ka ibu karịa mgbe e kewara ya n'akụkụ hà nhata 5. Ya mere 1/4 m dị ogologo karịa 1/5 m.
l-m-e4-b05-32.s.s2.model.0: Iberibe 1 m e kewara n'akụkụ hà nhata 4 ka ibu karịa nke e kewara n'akụkụ hà nhata 5, ya mere 1/4 m dị ogologo, nkọwa B ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b05-32.s.s2.model.1: Ka ị na-ekewa ya n'akụkụ karịa, iberibe nke ọ bụla na-adị mkpụmkpụ; ya mere 1/5 m, nke denominator ya ka ukwuu, dị mkpụmkpụ n'ezie.

l-m-e4-b05-33.title: Kedu akpịrịkpa gosiri mgbanwe okpomọkụ nke ọma?
l-m-e4-b05-33.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere akpịrịkpa eserese ahịrị abụọ na-egosi mgbanwe okpomọkụ, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe ndabere ya.
l-m-e4-b05-33.material: Okpomọkụ ehihie n'ime ụbọchị 5 bụ 21°, 22°, 24°, 23°, 26°. A: See akpịrịkpa kwụ ọtọ site na 0° ruo 40° n'ogo 5°. B: See akpịrịkpa kwụ ọtọ site na 20° ruo 28° n'ogo 1°, belata 0 ruo 20° site n'ahịrị na-efegharị.
l-m-e4-b05-33.s.s1.prompt: Kedu eserese gosiri obere mgbanwe nke ọma?
l-m-e4-b05-33.s.s1.r.a: N'ogo 5°, mgbanwe 1° ruo 2° anaghị ahụ nke ọma.
l-m-e4-b05-33.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ dị mfe ịhụ otu
l-m-e4-b05-33.s.s1.r.c: A na-eme ka mgbanwe ahụ yie nke dị larịị, ya mere ọ dị iche na B.
l-m-e4-b05-33.s.s1.r.d: Dabere n'ogo akpịrịkpa, mkpọda ahịrị na-adị iche.
l-m-e4-b05-33.s.s1.explain: Uru ndị ahụ bụ 21 ruo 26, ya mere ọ bụrụ na e belata ihe na-erughị 20° site n'ahịrị na-efegharị ma kee n'ogo 1°, obere mgbanwe na-adị ka nnukwu.
l-m-e4-b05-33.s.s2.model.0: Uru niile dị n'etiti 21° na 26°, ya mere ịrị elu na ọdịda pụtara ìhè karịa na eserese B e kewara n'ogo 1°.
l-m-e4-b05-33.s.s2.model.1: A na-eji nwayọọ nwayọọ 5° kee akpịrịkpa A, ya mere ọdịiche 1° ruo 3° na-adị ka nke dị larịị; B nke e kewara n'ụzọ zuru ezu bụ nhọrọ ziri ezi.

l-m-e4-b01-08.topic: Nọmba mkpụrụọnụọgụ ise dabara n'ọnọdụ ndị ahụ
l-m-e4-b01-08.goal: Maka ime paswọọdụ, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b01-08.material: Ị na-eme paswọọdụ mkpụrụọnụọgụ ise. Ọnọdụ: mkpụrụọnụọgụ iri puku bụ 4, mkpụrụọnụọgụ otu bụ 0, mkpụrụọnụọgụ ise niile ga-adị iche. Họrọ nọmba kacha ukwuu n'ime ọnọdụ ndị a.
l-m-e4-b01-08.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nọmba kacha ukwuu na-emezu ọnọdụ niile?
l-m-e4-b01-08.s.s1.r.a: Mkpụrụọnụọgụ iri puku bụ 9, ọ bụghị 4.
l-m-e4-b01-08.s.s1.r.d: 9 pụtara ugboro abụọ, ya mere mkpụrụọnụọgụ niile adịghị iche.

l-m-e4-b01-08.s.s2.model.0: Debe ebe iri puku ka ọ bụrụ 4, ebe otu ka ọ bụrụ 0, tinye 9, 8, 7 n'ebe ndị ọzọ malite na nke kacha ukwuu, ka mkpụrụọnụọgụ niile dị iche, nọmba ahụ bụrụ 49870.
l-m-e4-b01-08.s.s2.model.1: 49980 na-emegharị 9, 94870 na 49875 na-emebi ọnọdụ ebe, ya mere nọmba kacha ukwuu na-emezu ọnọdụ niile bụ 49870.

l-m-e4-b01-16.title: Ikewa mabul 150 n'ime igbe
l-m-e4-b01-16.goal: Maka ụzọ e si ekewa mabul n'ime igbe, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b01-16.material: Tinye mabul 150 n'ime igbe n'ọnụọgụ ha nhata, n'enweghị nke fọdụrụ. Ọnọdụ: jiri igbe 10 ruo 20, tinye ma ọ dịkarịa ala mabul 12 n'ime igbe nke ọ bụla.
l-m-e4-b01-16.s.s1.o.a: Igbe 12 nke nwere mabul 12 n'ime nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b01-16.s.s1.o.b: Igbe 20 nke nwere mabul 7 n'ime nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b01-16.s.s1.r.b: 7×20=140; ya mere mabul 10 fọdụrụ, 7 dịkwa ala karịa 12.
l-m-e4-b01-16.s.s1.o.c: Igbe 10 nke nwere mabul 15 n'ime nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b01-16.s.s1.o.d: Igbe 15 nke nwere mabul 10 n'ime nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b01-16.s.s1.r.d: Igbe nke ọ bụla chọrọ ma ọ dịkarịa ala 12, ma e nwere 10.
l-m-e4-b01-16.s.s1.explain: Naanị ọnụọgụ igbe na-ekewa 150 n'enweghị ihe fọdụrụ bụ 10 na 15; n'ime ha, naanị igbe 10 na-enye ma ọ dịkarịa ala 12 n'ime nke ọ bụla.
l-m-e4-b01-16.s.s2.model.0: N'iji igbe 10 nke nwere 15 n'ime nke ọ bụla, e tinyela 150 niile n'enweghị nke fọdụrụ, ma ọnụọgụ igbe na ọnọdụ opekata mpe 12 mezuru; ya mere ọ dabara adaba.
l-m-e4-b01-16.s.s2.model.1: Igbe 15 nwere 10 n'ime nke ọ bụla, nke dị ala karịa 12; igbe 12 na-ahapụ 6 fọdụrụ; ya mere naanị igbe 10 nke nwere 15 n'ime nke ọ bụla na-emezu ọnọdụ niile.

l-m-e4-b01-24.title: Ịhọrọ karama abụọ na ịwụsa ha n'ime akpa
l-m-e4-b01-24.goal: N'ịhọrọ karama iji jide ihe ọṅụṅụ, tụlee ọnọdụ ọ bụla na-emegide ibe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kwesịrị ekwesị kacha, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-m-e4-b01-24.material: E nwere ihe ọṅụṅụ 1 and 3/5 L n'Karama A, 2/5 L n'Karama B, na 4/5 L n'Karama C. Ị chọrọ ịhọrọ karama abụọ ma jikọta ha n'ime akpa 2 L na-adịghị awụpụ, na-eju ya dị ka o kwere mee.
l-m-e4-b01-24.s.s1.prompt: Kedu karama abụọ kwesịrị ọnọdụ ndị ahụ kacha?
l-m-e4-b01-24.s.s1.r.b: E kpebiri iji naanị karama abụọ, ma nchikọta bụkwa 2 and 4/5 L.
l-m-e4-b01-24.s.s1.r.c: Nchikọta bụ 2 and 2/5 L, ya mere ọ na-awụpụ n'akpa.
l-m-e4-b01-24.s.s1.r.d: Nchikọta bụ 1 and 1/5 L, ya mere ọ na-ekwesị, ma ọ bụghị nke kacha.
l-m-e4-b01-24.s.s1.explain: A+B bụ 2 L, nke na-eju akpa ahụ kpọmkwem. A+C bụ 2 and 2/5 L, ya mere ọ na-awụpụ.
l-m-e4-b01-24.s.s2.model.0: Nchikọta Karama A na Karama B bụ 2 L, ya mere ọ naghị awụpụ ma bụrụ nke kacha enwere ike ijide.
l-m-e4-b01-24.s.s2.model.1: A+C bụ 2 and 2/5 L, ya mere ọ na-awụpụ, ma B+C bụ naanị 1 and 1/5 L, ya mere A+B kwesịrị kacha.

l-m-e4-b01-32.goal: N'ụzọ nke ịkwatu eriri n'ogologo hà nhatanụ, tụlee ọnọdụ ọ bụla na-emegide ibe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kwesịrị ekwesị kacha, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-m-e4-b01-32.material: Kwatuo eriri 3.2 m n'ogologo hà nhatanụ n'enweghị ihe fọdụrụ. Ọnọdụ: akụkụ ọ bụla bụ opekata mpe 0.5 m ma kacha 0.8 m, ma ogologo bụ ọnụọgụ decimal nwere otu ebe.
l-m-e4-b01-32.s.s1.o.a: Akụkụ 5 nke 0.64 m nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b01-32.s.s1.r.a: 0.64 bụ ọnụọgụ decimal nwere ebe abụọ.
l-m-e4-b01-32.s.s1.o.b: Akụkụ 4 nke 0.8 m nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b01-32.s.s1.o.c: Akụkụ 8 nke 0.4 m nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b01-32.s.s1.o.d: Iberibe 6, nke ọ bụla bụ 0.5 m

l-m-e4-b01-32.s.s2.model.0: Site n'iberibe 4 nke 0.8 m, a na-eji 3.2 m niile n'enweghị ihe fọdụrụ; ogologo ya bụkwa ọnụọgụ ntụpọ nwere otu ebe, nke dịkarịa ala 0.5 m ma karịa 0.8 m, ya mere ọ dabara.

l-m-e4-b01-40.topic: Triangle nke na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ
l-m-e4-b01-40.goal: Mgbe ị na-ekpebi akụkụ atọ nke triangle, tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegide ibe ha, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b01-40.material: Kpebie akụkụ atọ nke triangle. Ọnọdụ: otu akụkụ sara mbara, akụkụ abụọ nke ọzọ hà nhata, nchikọta akụkụ atọ ahụ ga-agbasokwa iwu triangle.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s1.prompt: Kedu akụkụ atọ na-emezu ọnọdụ niile?
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s1.r.a: Akụkụ abụọ nke ọzọ, 25° na 35°, ahaghị nhata.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s1.r.c: Nchikọta ahụ bụ 185°, ya mere ha enweghị ike ịbụ akụkụ atọ nke triangle.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s1.r.d: 90° bụ akụkụ ziri ezi, ya mere ọ bụghị akụkụ sara mbara.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s1.explain: 110° sara mbara, 35° na 35° hà nhata, nchikọta ha bụkwa 180°.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s2.model.0: 110°+35°+35°=180°, 110° sara mbara, akụkụ abụọ nke ọzọ hà nhata, ya mere akụkụ atọ ndị a ziri ezi.
l-m-e4-b01-40.s.s2.model.1: Nchikọta ahụ ga-abụ 180°, nke ọ bụla agaghị abụ akụkụ ziri ezi, akụkụ abụọ ahụ agaghịkwa adị iche. Ya mere naanị ndị na-emezu ọnọdụ atọ ahụ bụ 110°, 35°, 35°.

l-m-e4-b02-08.topic: Apapọ awọn nọmba nla ati awọn ipo
l-m-e4-b02-08.goal: Ninu awọn ọna pipin ẹbun 1 hundred-million won, ṣe iwọn gbogbo ipo ti o tako ara wọn; yan adehun ti o baamu julọ ki o ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e4-b02-08.material: Pin gbogbo ẹbun 1 hundred-million won laarin ile-iwe mẹta, A, B, ati C. Awọn ipo: ile-iwe kọọkan gba o kere ju 2 ten-million won; A gba ju B lọ; iye fun awọn ile-iwe mẹta gbọdọ yatọ gbogbo wọn.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.prompt: Ọna pipin wo ni o tẹle gbogbo awọn ipo?
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.a: A 3 ten-million, B 4 ten-million, C 3 ten-million
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.r.a: A kere ju B lọ, awọn iye naa si tun dọgba.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.b: A 5 ten-million, B 3 ten-million, C 2 ten-million
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.c: A 4 ten-million, B 3 ten-million, C 3 ten-million
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.r.c: B ati C jẹ kanna, nitorina awọn iye kii ṣe gbogbo wọn yatọ.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.d: A 6 ten-million, B 3 ten-million, C 1 ten-million
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.r.d: C gba kere ju 2 ten-million won.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.explain: Ọna kan ṣoṣo ti apapọ rẹ jẹ 1 hundred-million, gbogbo wọn jẹ o kere ju 2 ten-million, A ju B lọ, ti gbogbo iye si yatọ ni 5 ten-million, 3 ten-million, 2 ten-million.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s2.model.0: 5 ten-million+3 ten-million+2 ten-million=1 hundred-million; gbogbo wọn kere ju 2 ten-million, A ju B lọ, gbogbo wọn si yatọ, nitorina o baamu.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s2.model.1: Awọn eto miiran ni iye ti o dọgba, ni 1 ten-million won, tabi A kere ju B lọ; nitorina eto yii nikan ni o tẹle gbogbo ipo.

l-m-e4-b02-16.title: Ịkwakọba akwụkwọ 180 n'ime igbe
l-m-e4-b02-16.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'otú e si akwakọba akwụkwọ n'ime igbe, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b02-16.material: Kwakọba akwụkwọ 180 n'ime igbe, ka ọnụọgụ dị n'igbe ọ bụla hà nhata, ghara inwe nke fọdụrụ. Ọnọdụ: ruo akwụkwọ 20 n'otu igbe, ma jiri igbe ole na ole o kwere mee.
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ kacha emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ?
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.o.a: Akwụkwọ 30 n'ime igbe 6, igbe nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.r.a: Otu igbe ga-enwe ihe karịrị akwụkwọ 20.
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.o.b: Akwụkwọ 20 n'ime igbe 9, igbe nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.o.c: Akwụkwọ 18 n'ime igbe 10, igbe nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma a pụkwara ịkwakọba ha n'ime igbe 9.
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.o.d: Akwụkwọ 15 n'ime igbe 12, igbe nke ọ bụla
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ, ma ọ na-eji igbe karịa.
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na e tinye akwụkwọ 20 n'igbe nke ọ bụla, a chọrọ igbe 9. Ọ bụrụ na igbe erughị 9, otu igbe ga-enwe ihe karịrị 20.
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s2.model.0: Site n'akwụkwọ 20 n'ime igbe 9 nke ọ bụla, a na-akwakọba akwụkwọ 180 niile n'enweghị nke fọdụrụ. Ọnọdụ nke ịbụ na ọ bụghị ihe karịrị 20 n'igbe ọ bụla mezukwara, ya mere ọ dabara.
l-m-e4-b02-16.s.s2.model.1: Igbe 10 na igbe 12 nwekwara ike, ma ha na-eji igbe karịa. Igbe 6 pụtara akwụkwọ 30 n'otu igbe, nke karịrị 20. Ya mere igbe 9 kacha dabara adaba.

l-m-e4-b02-24.title: Etiti kaadị kachasị obosara e ji rịbọn mee
l-m-e4-b02-24.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'etiti akụkụ anọ e ji rịbọn mee, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b02-24.material: Jiri 40 cm rịbọn niile mee etiti akụkụ anọ. Ọnọdụ: ogologo na obosara ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu cm dị iche iche, akụkụ ogologo agaghị akarị 12 cm, mee ka ọ saa mbara dịka o kwere mee.
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ogologo×obosara kacha emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ?
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, ma mpaghara ya pere mpe, ọ bụ 96.
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo na obosara hà nhata, ya mere ọ na-emegide ọnọdụ ahụ.
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na perimeta bụ 40 cm, nchikọta ogologo na obosara bụ 20 cm. N'ime nhọrọ ndị mezuru ọnọdụ, 11×9 nwere mpaghara 99, ọ bụkwa nke kachasị obosara.
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s2.model.0: Nchikọta ogologo na obosara bụ 20, 11 na 9 dị iche, n'ime nhọrọ ndị na-erughị ma ọ bụ hà nhata 12, mpaghara 99 kacha saa mbara. Ya mere 11×9 dabara adaba.
l-m-e4-b02-24.s.s2.model.1: 10×10 nwere ogologo hà nhata, 15×5 gafere 12, 12×8 nwere mpaghara 96 nke pere mpe karịa 99 nke 11×9. Ya mere 11×9 kacha dabara.

l-m-e4-b02-32.goal: Ṣe akiyesi gbogbo awọn ipo ti o tako ara wọn fun iye ninu ago kan; yan adehun to dara julọ ki o ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e4-b02-32.material: Tú oje 3 L si ago 8 ni iye dọgba. Ipo: iye ago kọọkan n lọ ni igbesẹ 0.05 L, o kere ju 0.25 L, ko ju 0.4 L lọ, oje ko gbọdọ kọja 3 L, ki o si tú iye to pọ julọ.

l-m-e4-b02-32.s.s1.explain: 0.4 L yoo di 3.2 L fun ago 8, o si ṣàn kọja; ninu awọn iye ti ko kọja, 0.35 L ni o tobi julọ ti o yẹ.

l-m-e4-b02-40.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta ibe ha maka bọs a ga-eji gaa njem mmụta, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b02-40.material: Mmadụ 45 na-aga n'ụgbọala bọs. Obere bọs na-ebu mmadụ 12 ma na-efu 3×10,000 won nke ọ bụla, bọs nke etiti na-ebu mmadụ 20 ma na-efu 5×10,000 won nke ọ bụla. Họrọ ụzọ ga-eburu mmadụ 45 niile ma were ego kacha nta.
l-m-e4-b02-40.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nhọrọ bọs kacha dabara adaba?
l-m-e4-b02-40.s.s1.r.b: Onye ọ bụla nwere ike ịnya, ma ọnụ ahịa ya dị elu, 15×10,000 won.
l-m-e4-b02-40.s.s1.o.c: 1 bọs nke etiti na obere bọs 2
l-m-e4-b02-40.s.s1.r.c: Naanị mmadụ 44 nwere ike ịnya, ya mere mmadụ 1 agaghị abanye.
l-m-e4-b02-40.s.s1.o.d: Bọs nke etiti 2 na obere bọs 1
l-m-e4-b02-40.s.s1.r.d: Onye ọ bụla nwere ike ịnya, ma ọnụ ahịa ya dị elu, 13×10,000 won.
l-m-e4-b02-40.s.s1.explain: Obere bọs 4 nwere ike iburu mmadụ 48 ma na-efu 12×10,000 won. Nhọrọ dị ọnụ ala nke 1 bọs nke etiti na obere bọs 2 na-ebu mmadụ 44, nke ezughị.
l-m-e4-b02-40.s.s2.model.0: Obere bọs 4 na-ebu mmadụ 48, ya mere mmadụ 45 niile nwere ike ịnya, ọnụ ahịa ya bụkwa nke kacha ala, 12×10,000 won, ya mere ọ dabara adaba.

l-m-e4-b04-36.goal: Wo gbogbo awọn ipo ti o tako ara wọn fun sisan 4,500 won pẹlu awọn iwe owo ati owo-irin; yan adehun to dara julọ ki o ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-36.material: O fẹ san 4,500 won gangan pẹlu iwe 1,000 won ati owo-irin 500 won. O le lo iwe 2 si 3 nikan, o si fẹ lo owo-irin diẹ bi o ti ṣee.
l-m-e4-b04-36.s.s1.prompt: Ọna wo ni o ba gbogbo ipo mu julọ?
l-m-e4-b04-36.s.s1.r.a: O jẹ 4,500 won, ṣugbọn iwe naa ju 3 lọ.
l-m-e4-b04-36.s.s1.r.b: O jẹ 4,500 won, ṣugbọn iwe naa kere ju 2 lọ.
l-m-e4-b04-36.s.s1.r.c: O ba awọn ipo mu, ṣugbọn o nilo owo-irin diẹ sii.
l-m-e4-b04-36.s.s1.explain: Awọn ọna meji wa lati ṣe 4,500 won pẹlu iwe 2 si 3. Ninu wọn, eyi ti o ni owo-irin diẹ, 3, ni o yẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-36.s.s2.model.0: Iwe 3 ati owo-irin 3 jẹ 3,000+1,500=4,500 won, iwe naa jẹ 3 tabi kere si; awọn ipo ṣẹ. O tun lo owo-irin diẹ julọ.
l-m-e4-b04-36.s.s2.model.1: Iwe 2 ati owo-irin 5 tun ṣee ṣe, ṣugbọn o nilo owo-irin diẹ sii; nitorina iwe 3 ati owo-irin 3, pẹlu owo-irin 3 nikan, dara julọ.

l-m-e4-b04-37.title: Yiyan okun kan
l-m-e4-b04-37.goal: Wo gbogbo awọn ipo ti o tako ara wọn fun yiyan okun iṣakojọpọ; yan adehun to dara julọ ki o ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-37.material: Lati di apoti, o nilo okun o kere ju 1.2 m; ṣugbọn ti o ba gun ju 2 m lọ, yoo di ọna mu, ko si ṣiṣẹ. Yan okun ti o fi okun to ku silẹ diẹ bi o ti ṣee.
l-m-e4-b04-37.s.s1.prompt: Okun wo ni o ba gbogbo ipo mu julọ?
l-m-e4-b04-37.s.s1.r.a: O kuru ju 1.2 m, nitorina ko le di apoti.
l-m-e4-b04-37.s.s1.r.c: A le lo, ṣugbọn okun to ku gun ju.
l-m-e4-b04-37.s.s1.r.d: O gun ju 2 m, nitorina o di ọna mu.
l-m-e4-b04-37.s.s1.explain: Awọn gigun laarin 1.2 m ati 2 m jẹ 1.25 m ati 1.9 m. Ninu wọn, eyi to kuru, 1.25 m, fi okun to ku diẹ silẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-37.s.s2.model.0: 1.25 m jẹ o kere ju 1.2 m ati pe ko ju 2 m lọ; o si kuru julọ, nitorina o fi okun to ku diẹ silẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-37.s.s2.model.1: 1.08 m ko to, 2.05 m si gun ju; kọ mejeeji silẹ ki o yan eyi to kuru ninu awọn meji to ku, 1.25 m.

l-m-e4-b04-38.title: Yiyan iwọn inaro aworan laini
l-m-e4-b04-38.goal: Wo gbogbo awọn ipo ti o tako ara wọn fun iwọn inaro aworan laini; yan adehun to dara julọ ki o ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-38.material: Awọn iye jẹ 15, 30, 45, 60. Awọn ipo: ① Gbogbo iye wa lori ila akoj. ② Awọn onigun inaro ko ju 12 lọ. ③ Awọn iye aladugbo yatọ ni o kere ju onigun iwọn 3. Yan iye onigun iwọn kan.
l-m-e4-b04-38.s.s1.prompt: Iye onigun iwọn wo ni o ba gbogbo ipo mu?
l-m-e4-b04-38.s.s1.r.a: 15 wa laarin awọn ila akoj, nitorina o tako ipo ①.
l-m-e4-b04-38.s.s1.r.b: Awọn iye aladugbo yatọ ni onigun 1 nikan, nitorina o tako ipo ③.
l-m-e4-b04-38.s.s1.r.c: 15, 30, 45 ko wa lori awọn ila akoj.
l-m-e4-b04-38.s.s1.explain: Pẹlu igbesẹ 5, gbogbo iye wa lori awọn ila, 60 jẹ onigun 12, iyatọ 15 si jẹ onigun 3. Gbogbo ipo mẹta ṣẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-38.s.s2.model.0: Ti onigun kan ba jẹ 5, 15, 30, 45, 60 wa lori ila, onigun 12 wa, iyatọ iye jẹ onigun 3; gbogbo ipo ṣẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-38.s.s2.model.1: Pẹlu 10, 15 wa laarin awọn ila, iyatọ 15 si jẹ onigun 1. 5 nikan ni o ba gbogbo ipo mẹta mu.

l-m-e4-b04-39.title: Pin akẹkọ 28 ni dọgba si awọn ẹgbẹ
l-m-e4-b04-39.goal: Wo gbogbo awọn ipo ti o tako ara wọn fun pipin akẹkọ 28 si ẹgbẹ; yan adehun to dara julọ ki o ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-39.material: O fẹ pin akẹkọ 28 si ẹgbẹ ti iwọn kanna lai fi ẹnikẹni silẹ. O fẹ ṣe ẹgbẹ o kere ju 3 ati pe ko ju 6 lọ.
l-m-e4-b04-39.s.s1.prompt: Nọmba ẹgbẹ wo ni o ba gbogbo ipo mu?
l-m-e4-b04-39.s.s1.r.a: 28÷3 ko pin ni deede, diẹ ninu akẹkọ yoo ku.
l-m-e4-b04-39.s.s1.r.b: 28÷5 ko pin ni deede, diẹ ninu akẹkọ yoo ku.
l-m-e4-b04-39.s.s1.r.c: O pin ni deede, ṣugbọn ẹgbẹ gbọdọ jẹ 6 tabi kere si.
l-m-e4-b04-39.s.s1.explain: 28÷4=7 pin ni deede, 4 si wa laarin 3 ati 6. Ẹgbẹ 7 naa pin, ṣugbọn o ju 6 lọ.
l-m-e4-b04-39.s.s2.model.0: 28÷4=7, nitorina ko si akẹkọ to ku; nọmba ẹgbẹ 4 wa laarin 3 ati 6, nitorina eyi ni yiyan to tọ.
l-m-e4-b04-39.s.s2.model.1: Pẹlu ẹgbẹ 3 ati 5 akẹkọ ku; ẹgbẹ 7 ju 6 lọ, nitorina ẹgbẹ 4 nikan ni o ba gbogbo ipo mu.

l-m-e4-b04-40.title: Fọwọsi igo 1 L pẹlu wara
l-m-e4-b04-40.goal: Wo gbogbo awọn ipo ti o tako ara wọn fun iye wara lati fi kun igo; yan adehun to dara julọ ki o ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e4-b04-40.material: Igo 1 L kan ni oje 3/8 L. O fi wara kun. Igo ko gbọdọ ṣàn; wara gbọdọ pọ ju oje lọ, o si fẹ kun igo bi o ti le ṣe.
l-m-e4-b04-40.s.s1.prompt: Elo wara ni o dara julọ lati fi kun?
l-m-e4-b04-40.s.s1.r.a: 3/8+6/8=9/8 ju 1 L lọ, nitorina o ṣàn kọja.
l-m-e4-b04-40.s.s1.r.b: O kere ju oje (3/8 L), nitorina o tako ipo kan.
l-m-e4-b04-40.s.s1.r.d: O ba awọn ipo mu, ṣugbọn igo kun 7/8 nikan.
l-m-e4-b04-40.s.s1.explain: 3/8+5/8=8/8=1 L, nitorina igo kun. 5/8 tobi ju 3/8 lọ, ko si ṣàn.
l-m-e4-b04-40.s.s2.model.0: Ti o ba fi 5/8 L kun, 3/8+5/8=1 L; ko ṣàn, igo kun, wara si pọ ju oje lọ.
l-m-e4-b04-40.s.s2.model.1: 2/8 kere ju oje lọ, 6/8 si ṣàn kọja; wọn ko dara. Ninu 4/8 ati 5/8, 5/8 kun igo diẹ sii, nitorina o tọ.

l-m-e4-b05-36.title: Ịzụta pensụl agba nke ọma
l-m-e4-b05-36.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'ịzụta pensụl agba, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b05-36.material: Ị chọrọ pensụl agba 35, mmefu ego bụ 4,000 won ma ọ bụ obere. Pensụl nke ọ bụla bụ 120 won, otu mkpọ pensụl 12 bụ 1,200 won. Ị gaghị azụta ole na ole, ọnụ ọgụgụ fọdụrụ kwesịkwara ịdị ntakịrị dịka o kwere mee.
l-m-e4-b05-36.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ịzụta dabara adaba nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile?
l-m-e4-b05-36.s.s1.r.a: 35×120=4,200 won, ya mere ọ gafere mmefu ego 4,000 won.
l-m-e4-b05-36.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ 4,800 won, ya mere ọ karịrị mmefu ego.
l-m-e4-b05-36.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, ma pensụl 1 fọdụrụ.
l-m-e4-b05-36.s.s1.explain: Mkpọ 2 na pensụl 11 n'otu n'otu na-efu 2,400+1,320=3,720 won ma bụrụ pensụl 35 kpọmkwem. Ọ dabara na mmefu ego, ọ dịghịkwa nke fọdụrụ.
l-m-e4-b05-36.s.s2.model.0: Mkpọ 2 na pensụl 11 n'otu n'otu na-efu 3,720 won, ya mere ọ dabara na mmefu ego, na-enye pensụl 35 n'enweghị ihe fọdụrụ, nke a bụ nhọrọ kacha mma.
l-m-e4-b05-36.s.s2.model.1: Mkpọ 3 na-efu 3,600 won, dabara na mmefu ego, ma pensụl 1 fọdụrụ; ya mere mkpọ 2 na pensụl 11 n'otu n'otu, nke na-ahapụghị ihe ọ bụla, ka mma.

l-m-e4-b05-37.title: Ime triangle site n'osisi atọ
l-m-e4-b05-37.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'ịhọrọ osisi atọ iji mee triangle, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b05-37.material: Mee triangle site n'osisi atọ n'ime ndị dị 3 cm, 4 cm, 5 cm, 7 cm. Iji mee triangle, osisi kachasị ogologo ga-adị mkpụmkpụ karịa nchikọta osisi abụọ ndị ọzọ. Ị chọrọ ka gburugburu ya dị ogologo dịka o kwere mee.
l-m-e4-b05-37.s.s1.prompt: Kedu osisi atọ na-emezu ọnọdụ niile nke ọma?
l-m-e4-b05-37.s.s1.r.a: 3+4=7, nke na-adịbeghị ogologo karịa osisi kachasị ogologo, ya mere ọ naghị eme triangle.
l-m-e4-b05-37.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-eme triangle, ma e nwere ngwakọta nwere gburugburu karịrị 12 cm.
l-m-e4-b05-37.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-eme triangle, ma e nwere ngwakọta nwere gburugburu karịrị 15 cm.

l-m-e4-b05-38.title: Ijikọ tebụl iji mee oche
l-m-e4-b05-38.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'ijikọ tebụl n'ahịrị iji mepụta oche, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b05-38.material: Ọ bụrụ na ijikọta tebụl akụkụ anọ n'otu ahịrị, tebụl n na-anọdụ mmadụ (n×2+2). Ọ dịkarịa ala mmadụ 30 ga-anọdụ, a pụrụ iji tebụl 15 karịa, oche efu kwesịkwara ịdị ole na ole dịka o kwere mee.
l-m-e4-b05-38.s.s1.prompt: Tebụl ole na-emezu ọnọdụ niile nke ọma?
l-m-e4-b05-38.s.s1.r.a: 13×2+2=28 mmadụ, ya mere mmadụ 30 enweghị ike ịnọdụ.
l-m-e4-b05-38.s.s1.r.c: Mmadụ 32 nwere ike ịnọdụ, ya mere ọnọdụ ahụ mezuru, ma oche 2 tọgbọ chakoo.
l-m-e4-b05-38.s.s1.r.d: Tebụl ga-abụ 15 ma ọ bụ ole na ole.
l-m-e4-b05-38.s.s1.explain: Tebụl 14 na-anọdụ mmadụ 14×2+2=30 kpọmkwem. Tebụl 15 na-anọdụ mmadụ 32, ya mere oche 2 tọgbọ chakoo.
l-m-e4-b05-38.s.s2.model.0: Tebụl 14 na-anọdụ mmadụ 30 kpọmkwem n'enweghị oche efu, ọ dịghịkwa karịa 15, ya mere ọ kacha dabara adaba.
l-m-e4-b05-38.s.s2.model.1: Tebụl 13 ezughị, tebụl 16 karịrị 15, ya mere ha agaghị arụ ọrụ. N'ime tebụl 14 na 15, họrọ 14 nke na-ahapụ oche efu ole na ole.

l-m-e4-b05-39.title: Ịhọrọ ngwa ụlọ akwụkwọ n'ime mmefu ego
l-m-e4-b05-39.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'ịhọrọ ngwa ụlọ akwụkwọ atọ, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e4-b05-39.material: Ị chọrọ ịzụta ngwa ụlọ akwụkwọ 3. Mmefu ego bụ 3,700 won ma ọ bụ obere, akwụkwọ ndetu ga-adị n'ime ha, ego fọdụrụ ga-adịkwa ntakịrị dịka o kwere mee. Akwụkwọ ndetu bụ 900 won, mkpịsị odee 1,200 won, ruler 700 won, ihe mmado 1,500 won.
l-m-e4-b05-39.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nchikota na-emezu ọnọdụ niile nke ọma?
l-m-e4-b05-39.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, ma 900 won fọdụrụ, e nwekwara nchikota na-ahapụ obere ego.
l-m-e4-b05-39.s.s1.o.b: Akwụkwọ ndetu, mkpịsị odee, ihe mmado
l-m-e4-b05-39.s.s1.r.c: O ba ipo mu, ṣugbọn 600 won ku.
l-m-e4-b05-39.s.s1.r.d: Iwe akọsilẹ ko si, nitorina o tako ipo.
l-m-e4-b05-39.s.s1.explain: Awọn akojọpọ 3 wa ti o ni iwe akọsilẹ ti iye owo wọn jẹ 3,700 won tabi kere si. Eyi ti o fi owo to ku diẹ julọ, 100 won, jẹ iwe akọsilẹ, pen, sitika.
l-m-e4-b05-39.s.s2.model.0: Iwe akọsilẹ, pen, sitika jẹ 3,600 won, nitorina o wa laarin isuna, 100 won nikan si ku; o baamu julọ.
l-m-e4-b05-39.s.s2.model.1: Pen, rula, sitika ko ṣiṣẹ nitori iwe akọsilẹ ko si; ninu awọn miiran, akojọpọ 3,600 won ti o fi owo to ku diẹ ni o dara.
